{{Quote|Unfortunately, the Sith military blockade has grounded my vessel.|Davik Kang|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The '''Sith military''' was the armed forces of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] and the [[Sith Triumvirate]] during the [[Dark Wars]] and [[First Jedi Purge]].<ref name="KOTOR" /><ref name="KOTOR2" />

==History==
===Origin===
{{Main|Mandalorian Wars}}
[[File:Sideshow-DarthRevanWilloftheForce.png|thumb|left|250px|Sith forces rally behind Darth Revan]]
The Sith military's roots began in the [[Mandalorian Wars]], with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] appointed [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] and granted direct command of a third of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref><ref name="KOTOR" /> Towards the end of the Mandalorian Wars, Revan began to fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. At the climatic [[Battle of Malachor V]], Revan used the [[Mass Shadow Generator/Legends|Mass Shadow Generator]] to destroy the Mandalorian fleet. This also solidified his control over his forces, as many of the Republic casualties were among forces not directly loyal to him.<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> Following the end of the war, Revan's Republic forces followed him into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Officially this campaign was directed at eliminating [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusader]] remnant, however the actual purpose was to seek out the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], which had secretly reformed after the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] and orchestrated the Mandalorian Wars.<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>

Following Revan and [[Darth Malak|Malak's]] fall to the dark side at the hands of the [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]], the pair were tasked to locate the [[Star Forge]] however, they broke free and established their own [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] and organized their Republic forces as the Sith military.<ref name="Old Republic Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

===Jedi Civil War===
{{Main|Jedi Civil War}}
[[File:JediCivilWar.jpg|thumb|300px|Military movement in the Jedi Civil War.]]
Reconstituted by the near-limitless production capability of the Star Forge, the Sith military had the manpower and personnel to mount a full scale assault on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The opening battle of the [[Jedi Civil War]] was the [[Battle of Foerost (Jedi Civil War)|Battle of Foerost]] in [[3959 BBY]], during which the Sith military captured a significant portion of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] fleet at the [[Foerost Shipyards]].<ref name="KOTOR" /><ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Significant segments of the Republic Military defected to the Sith military, enabling rapid advances with minimal casualties. Logistics support and materiel was provided by agreement with the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

During [[3958 BBY]], Republic Navy [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]] defected to the Sith Empire. One of his first acts as a Sith admiral was to lead the [[Bombing of Telos IV]]. The [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] was unprecedented in its scale, killing millions and served to send a message to the Republic on how far the Sith were willing to go. In [[3957 BBY]], Darth Revan was [[Capture of Darth Revan|captured]] by the Jedi, however [[Darth Malak]] attempted to kill his former master and sized leadership of the Sith Empire and its military.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Following Malak's assumption of leadership, the military campaign shifted from strategic conquest, with an emphasis on preserving industrial capacity, to one of total war. In [[3956 BBY]] the Sith military [[Capture of Taris|captured]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and launched an [[Attack on the Endar Spire|attack]] on the Republic [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Endar Spire]]'' in an attempt to neutralize [[Bastila Shan]]. Following Shan's [[Rescue of Bastila Shan|rescue]] by Revan, who had his brain wiped and was now working for the Republic, Darth Malak directed the [[destruction of Taris]] which killed billions of citizens and shocked the galaxy.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Sith forces engaged with Revan during his quest for the [[Star Map]]s during his [[Raid on the Sith Embassy|raid on the Manaan Sith Embassy]]. At Darth Malak's direction, the Sith military launched an [[Attack on Dantooine (Jedi Civil War)|attack]] on Dantooine, executing orbital bombardment and surface operations, destroying the [[Jedi Enclave]] and occupying the planet. Sith forces also briefly captured Revan before he [[Skirmish aboard the Leviathan|escaped]] after killing Admiral Karath aboard the [[Interdictor-class cruiser|''Interdictor''-class cruiser]] [[Leviathan (Interdictor-class cruiser)|''Leviathan'']]. Revan proceeded to [[Skirmish on Korriban|eliminate]] the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] while finding the last Star Map. The [[Battle of Rakata Prime]] marked the end of the war, with the death of Darth Malak, the destruction of the Star Force, and fracturing of the Sith Empire and its military. General uprisings occurred, such as the [[Ahto Uprising]], as worlds revolted against Sith rule.<ref name="KOTOR" />

===Dark Wars===
{{Main|Dark Wars}}
While the Sith Empire had fractured and various Sith lords and military commanders fought for power as their influence crumbled, elements eventually coalesced into the [[Sith Triumvirate]] led by [[Kreia|Darth Traya]], [[Darth Nihilus]], and [[Darth Sion]]. While they did not have the outward power that Revan did, either in troops or materiel, the Sith Triumvirate instead opted for covert action by [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] to execute the [[First Jedi Purge]].<ref name="KOTOR2" />

During the [[Conclave at Katarr]] Darth Nihilus wiped out life across the entire planet and killed many members of [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. Sith forces under Darth Sion pursued the Jedi Exile [[Meetra Surik]] to [[Peragus II]], [[Skirmish at Peragus II|destroying]] the vitally critical source of fuel for [[Citadel Station]] at [[Telos IV]]. Sith forces under Darth Nihilus also intervened in the [[Onderon Civil War]] on behalf of the [[Onderon separatists]], first covertly, then overtly during the [[Battle of Onderon (Onderon Civil War)|Second Battle of Onderon]]. Darth Nihilus then [[Battle of Telos IV|assaulted]] Telos IV with the remainder of his space and ground forces, before being killed by Surik. The Sith Triumvirate and Sith military were finally defeated in the [[Battle of Malachor]], with the death of Darth Traya and Darth Sion marking the end of the Dark Wars and First Jedi Purge in [[3951 BBY]].<ref name="KOTOR2" />

==Organization and personnel==
The military's [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were called commonly called [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|Sith troopers]] and wore silver [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]] completely hiding their natural bodies.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Many of the Sith military's [[officer]]s and enlisted personnel were former members of the [[Republic Army]] and [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] who defected prior to, or during the start of, the [[Jedi Civil War]]. Notable senior officers include [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]], who led the Sith military's space forces after his [[Saul Karath's predecessor|predecessor]] was removed for questioning the orders of Darth Malak, Admiral [[Varko (Human)|Varko]], who succeeded Admiral Karath,<ref name="KOTOR" /> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Derred]], and [[Mon Halan]].<ref name="KOTOR2" />
